description: A mapping diagram, wide 16:9, two columns joined by thin horizontal arrows. LEFT column header 'What you built by hand (Lecture 5)', a tall light grey rounded box containing six stacked rounded boxes, top to bottom: 'System prompt and tool registry', 'The loop: call the model, run tools, repeat', 'Step cap and stop rules', 'History across messages and days', 'Trace of every step', 'Checks before a write'. RIGHT column header 'What a framework calls it', a tall light sky-blue rounded box containing six stacked rounded boxes aligned with the left ones: 'Agent', 'Runner', 'max turns', 'Session', 'Tracing', 'Guardrails'. Each left box has one arrow to the box beside it on the right. Under the right column, one extra sky-blue box 'Handoffs: one agent passes the job to another', with no box on its left. Under the left column a small grey note 'Tools come from the same MCP server in both'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A test-bench diagram, wide 16:9, left to right. At the far left a rounded box 'The same 12 tasks' with a small note under it 'Kavita, Rohit and Neha, scripted'. An arrow to a column of five stacked rounded boxes, each the same size, labelled top to bottom: 'Our harness (Lecture 5)', 'OpenAI Agents SDK', 'Google ADK', 'LangGraph agent', 'LangGraph control graph'. From the column, two arrows leave to the right. The upper arrow goes to a sky-blue rounded box 'Meter: one OpenAI-compatible gateway' with a small note 'records every reply, counts tokens and rupees', and from it an arrow to a box 'OpenRouter' and then to a box 'gemini-3.8-flash'. The lower arrow goes to a light grey rounded box 'MCP server over HTTP' with a note 'the Lecture 4 toolbox, 15 tools', and from it an arrow to a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. At the far right, a green rounded box 'Code checks read Bahi: pass, never-events' with a thin arrow from the Bahi box. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A four-column comparison diagram, wide 16:9. Across the very top, one wide rounded box spanning all columns: 'Kavita: Reorder 20,000 of the 5-litre gaskets from Deccan Polymers, PRD-07'. Below it four tall columns, each a light rounded panel with a header: column 1 header 'Our harness', column 2 header 'OpenAI Agents SDK', column 3 header 'Google ADK', column 4 header 'LangGraph'. In each column four small rounded boxes stacked top to bottom with thin downward arrows between them. Column 1: 'Harness: prompt and tools', 'loop in respond()', 'messages list', 'trace list'. Column 2: 'Agent', 'Runner.run', 'SQLiteSession', 'spans'. Column 3: 'LlmAgent', 'Runner.run_async', 'SessionService', 'Events'. Column 4: 'create_react_agent', 'graph: agent node and tools node', 'checkpointer', 'stream of updates'. Below all four columns, one wide light grey bar spanning all columns: 'MCP: the same 15 tools', and under it one wide soft ember-orange bar: 'Bahi ERP: PR/2026/04417, Rohit approves, PO/2026/01182 released'. Thin arrows from the bottom of every column down into the MCP bar. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A hub diagram, wide 16:9. On the left, three stacked rounded boxes: 'Ask Rasoi', 'Workflow Studio', 'Evals'. Thin arrows from all three go right into one central sky-blue rounded box labelled 'Model gateway' with three small lines inside it: 'one API', 'fallback when a model fails', 'cost and token log per call'. From the gateway, four thin arrows go right to four stacked rounded boxes: 'Google Gemini', 'OpenAI GPT', 'DeepSeek', 'Local model on our own GPU'. Under the gateway box, a small grey note: 'OpenRouter is a hosted gateway. LiteLLM is one you run yourself.' labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A two-panel comparison diagram, wide 16:9, with a thin vertical divider. LEFT panel header 'Hosted model': a rounded box 'Rasoi data centre' containing two small boxes 'Ask Rasoi' and 'Bahi ERP'; an arrow leaves the box to the right, crossing a dashed line labelled 'company boundary', to a box 'Model provider in the cloud'; on the arrow the label 'prompt, supplier prices, tool results'. RIGHT panel header 'Local model': a single rounded box 'Rasoi data centre' containing three small boxes 'Ask Rasoi', 'Bahi ERP' and 'Ollama on our own GPU', with short arrows between them all inside the box; a dashed line labelled 'company boundary' around the outside with no arrow crossing it. Under the right panel a small green note 'Nothing leaves the building'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A routing diagram, wide 16:9. At the top a rounded box 'Message from Kavita or Neha'. An arrow down to a sky-blue rounded box 'Front desk' with a small note under it 'no tools, it only hands off'. From the front desk three arrows fan out down to three rounded boxes in a row. Left box 'Policy desk' with a small list under it 'search_policy'. Middle box 'Purchasing desk' with a small list under it 'find_item, check_stock, find_supplier, create_purchase_request, create_purchase_order, release_purchase_order'. Right box 'Stores desk' with a small list under it 'order_status, receive_goods'. On the left of the front desk, a small green rounded box 'Input guardrail: never approve or skip an approval' with a thin line to the front desk. Along the bottom, one wide light grey bar 'MCP: each desk sees only its own tools'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram, top to bottom, wide 16:9. Top: a light grey band 'Where people work' containing three rounded boxes in a row: 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'. An arrow down to a highlighted sky-blue band with a thick blue outline, labelled on its left 'Harness: the agent loop'; inside it a row of four small rounded boxes 'Our harness', 'OpenAI Agents SDK', 'Google ADK', 'LangGraph', and under them a small line 'any of these can run the loop'. To the right of this band, a small sky-blue box 'Model gateway: OpenRouter, LiteLLM' with an arrow to two boxes 'Cloud models' and 'Local model: Ollama'. An arrow down from the harness band to a thin grey bar 'MCP'. Below it a light grey box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'. At the bottom a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services'. On the far right, a tall green rounded box running the full height labelled vertically 'Trust: identity, approvals, evals, traces, recovery'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.
